objective: Bring twenty-four Robo-mechanical Guts to Shoni in Stormwind.

description: It's terrible, <name>. We are not going to have enough parts to get our fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to Dun Morogh.
What we need are spare parts, <name>. What better place to get the spare parts for our vehicles than Gnomeregan? I hear that bots and mechs roam around that place like cattle on an open range.
What I need you to do is go to Gnomeregan and tear apart those robots. Bring me back their robot guts. Two dozen should be sufficient.
progress: If this were a race, you would have lost by now.
completion: This will do nicely, <name>. One gyrodrillmatic excavationator fixed; 398 left to go.
